reviews.text: Wagtail has honestly been such a great help, I have trained a few dogs myself but having a Great Dane puppy I wanted to make it there was no room for mistake ! I have learned so much a feel the 6 week course was only the beginning of our long journey wagtails dog training. 100% recommend

Tracey who helped us with our bernese
puppy was  brilliant. She has a great wealth of knowledge on how to tackle the issues with our dog and always came with a big smile and lots of dog treats 😊. …

I was feeling quite stressed when I first got my puppy, but thanks to Tracy, I’ve learnt so much about puppy behaviour and now feel more confident knowing what to expect. She is very knowledgeable, patient, and fantastic with my puppy. I’ve found her guidance so helpful and would highly recommend Tracy to anyone looking for a great dog trainer!

Tracy is absolutely great and professional with her gig. She structures her lessons very well and enforces training only with pawsitivity.

Would recommend her to anyone. What’s most helpful is that she sends over detailed session notes which act as a very useful guide.

She not only trains your pet but also the pawrents.
Tracy was excellent - really knowledgable, supportive and tailored everything to our specific situation. Could not have got to where we are without her. Highly recommended.

Tracy is a brilliant trainer. She came to my home to help me and my 10 week old puppy and gave practical, easy to follow advice. She is professional, knowledgeable and gives thorough follow up plans. She immediately boosted my confidence as a new, first time dog owner. I will be booking in more sessions with her and I cannot recommend her highly enough!

We had an early consultation with Tracy when new puppy parenting got a bit too much. She gave us some great tips on how to calm her down in the evenings and taught us a lot in a short space of time.

Amazingly she is also constantly checking in with us on WhatsApp and giving us on the fly advice which also worked and gave us peace of mind in tough moments.

She is possibly the most caring and supportive individual I’ve ever dealt with, and I cannot recommend her highly enough to anyone going through the puppy blues and is overwhelmed by the amount of information online. She cuts right to the chase with practical tips and advice and insights into why puppies do the crazy things they do.

We’ll definitely be using her again in the future and if you’re undecided you will not be disappointed.

Thanks Tracy!
We found Tracy to be a fantastic person and trainer who was available day and night, 7 days a week for help if needed. We would highly recommend her to train your dog.
Tracy is professional, dedicated and knowledgeable. She ensured we had a great start with our little Shih Tzu.
Tracy was brilliant. She sniffed out exactly what we needed to do with our pup and helped us trained her to exactly what we wanted. Couldn’t recommend enough!

Tracy is an absolutely amazing trainer. Before we got Tracy, we had no clue to do with our 12 week old puppy Lundun. After we met Tracy, we learned all the enrichment game which keeps our puppy happy 😊 Tracy does not just train your dog, she trains the owner to train the dog. I now feel very confident in front of my pup. The most important thing is that Tracy truly loves and cares about dogs. I would definitely recommend Tracy - Wagtail Training to everyone! It’s so worth it!

We highly recommend Tracy! She was a huge help when training our Labrador as a puppy. Her advice was practical, easy to follow, and made a real difference. Thanks to Tracy, our family dog is now wonderfully well-behaved and a pleasure to be around.

As first-time dog owners, we honestly couldn’t have asked for a better trainer than Tracy . From day one, she was incredibly knowledgeable, professional, and supportive, helping us navigate all the challenges that come with raising a puppy.

What really stood out was her patience and empathy. No question was ever too small, and she was always available when we needed guidance or reassurance. She understood how overwhelming the experience can be for new owners and consistently provided practical advice, encouragement, and confidence when we needed it most.

Thanks to her support, Mishti has made fantastic progress, but just as importantly, she helped us become better and more confident dog owners. We are truly grateful for her dedication, kindness, and expertise, and would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a trainer who genuinely cares about both dogs and their humans.

Wagtail Training is AMAZING! I was so helpless as a first time puppy owner, Tracy is super helpful with all the techniques and skills in supporting me and my puppy. I love all the notes that she has given, they are so detailed and informative which are super helpful for us to follow along and tailored to us. Chipp has become more compliance with instructions. Chipp loves Tracy so much, and every time there’s different kinds of treats 😆

Tracy was incredible and extremely knowledgeable with helping our little Milo grow into a loving & friendly pup that actually listens to us! She helped us work through our key areas we wanted Milo to focus on and we were amazed by how much he has picked up from her training methods! We can't wait to see how our little pup will grow into an incredible dog!

Tracy is absolutely brilliant! Her help has been invaluable on helping our puppy in her training journey. Very reliable and helpful at all times. She trains dogs through kindness and rewards and her bitesize tips along with the weekly notes make following her suggestions easy between sessions. Highly recommend!

We’ve just finished our sessions with Tracy and have been so pleased and grateful for all her help and advice. Her tips on biting, walking, attention, socialisation, and recall have been really helpful for us. She’s also been great about sharing resources on WhatsApp and checking in along the way. Our pup absolutely adores Tracy and clearly knows she’s the fun person with all the treats :) We would wholeheartedly recommend her. She is really amazing!!

Tracy has been an incredible help and would highly recommend her. In particular, the WhatsApp chats in between sessions make a huge difference. 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟

To give a little more context, we got our first puppy on Saturday, by the Tuesday we were really struggling. He wouldn’t settle at nights and as for toilet training, let’s not even go there. It’s well known that “consistency” is key, but with so much information on the internet/AI, knowing what to be consistent with is near impossible for a first time puppy owner.

We contacted a few trainers, and selected Tracy, party because she made time to do a session later that week. The first session was a game changer. She helped reorganise and optimise the layout of our home (crate moved from our bedroom to its permanent location) and generally put structure in place.

The WhatsApp chat between sessions meant we could share experiences and ask for more advice when something wasn’t quite working.

The only other point I’d add it’s that there is sooo much to learn, and as owners, it’s upon us to put things in practice. We decided to focus on the things most important to us (create training, toileting etc) before introducing other things, as there was only so much we could manage in any given week.

We cannot recommend Tracy highly enough! She brings a depth of knowledge and warmth that goes far beyond standard puppy training. Working with us and our Golden Retriever Akilis, Tracy helped us genuinely understand why he behaves the way he does - and that understanding has completely transformed our relationship with him. She has a wonderful ability to read both dog and owner, tailoring her approach so everything feels intuitive and achievable. If you want a trainer who empowers you as much as she trains your dog, Tracy is absolutely the one to call!

Tracey really helped me with my 15 week old puppy via remote support on whatsapp. She went out of her way to help (even while on holiday!) sending me lots of tips and advice, and answered any questions I had. We managed to get my puppy settled in a crate overnight via whatsapp messenger only, within two evenings he was easily settling in his crate all night. She also helped with calming him down, ensuring he was chewing the right things, and gave loads of advice on how to manage his schedule. I was so impressed we're now doing f2f sessions!
We learned a lot from Tracy and she went above and beyond with her communication, answering questions between sessions via whatsapp. Thank you Tracy!

Tracy is an incredible dog trainer! Super friendly, approachable, and full of helpful tips. She truly has a love for dogs, and it shows in her patience, dedication, and the way she tailors training to each pup’s personality. Our dog responded so well to her methods, and we feel much more confident as owners thanks to her guidance. Highly recommend Tracy to anyone looking for a trainer who genuinely cares about both the dogs and their humans!

Our offical dog aunt . Honestly a god send from day one. Highly reccomend! In paticular what really made me trust in investing training was her knowledge & how personable whilst remaining professional.  She helped us with toilet training on the pads before even meeting our puppy with clear instructions before our first session . We opted for the 6 sessions and it was never just 6 sessions, the value for money doesn't even cover the amount of effort tracey puts in above and beyond , she was on constant whatsapp hints and tips 24/7 (we probably drove you mad lol) everything was tailored and adapted to suit our gorgeous golden retriever who is now an angel (most of the time ). We continue to use her services for ongoing support. Daniel x

Tracy at Wagtails is absolutely amazing. She’s been providing training for us for over 3 months now and we’ve seen so much progression with our puppy, Pumpkin! Tracy tailors plans directly to our needs and understands exactly what to do through experience and intuition. She’s incredible value, provided support any time we’ve needed it, and she also has a good sense of humour which is a bonus and makes it fun! Thank you from us, and Pumpkin Tracy - look forward to seeing you for our next session!

Tracy was honestly great with our puppy. We did the 6 week course with her, with the first couple of sessions indoors and then the next few outside. She was really patient with our puppy who was quite bitey due to teething initially, but helped teach us the fundamentals of how to alleviate that. Personally I found learning the fundamentals super helpful as it helped me know how to calm our puppy down when she got too excited. Best thing about Tracy is her communication. She is available at all times via WhatsApp and that was definitely needed when we thought we were going crazy! Thanks again Tracy, mango will miss you

Tracy was absolutely first-class. Passionate about dog training, with incredible expertise. Helped us with some very nuanced situations from day one of our puppy arriving. The ongoing support was excellent (beyond the formal booked sessions). Not sure what we would have done without her!

Tracy’s training has truly been a game-changer for us and Pippo! She worked wonders with Pippo to correct his behaviour, but what really stood out was how she also empowered us as a family. Tracy didn’t just teach us how to manage Pippo’s behaviour; she gave us practical tools to improve our daily interactions with him. One of the most delightful things Tracy did was teach our 5-year-old daughter how to prepare healthy and tasty snacks for Pippo. It was such a fun, hands-on way to involve her in Pippo’s care and training, and now she takes great pride in looking after him!

Thanks to Tracy’s thoughtful and patient approach, Pippo is much better behaved, and our family dynamic has grown stronger. We all feel more connected to him, and the bond between Pippo, our daughter, and us has deepened. Tracy’s ability to work with each of us, including our little one, has made a huge difference, and we’re incredibly grateful for all she’s done. If you’re looking for a trainer who truly connects with both dogs and families, Tracy is the one!

If I could give more than 5 stars I would! Tracey has been such a massive help for us. I couldn't say thank you enough. She has been patient with us, gave us a lot of resources for our puppy, and has supported us so much. No question seemed to small or to silly. We couldn’t be better pawrents without Tracey’s support
Absolutely fantastic. If I could give more stars I would. Really knowledgeable, patient and effective. So helpful in the early weeks

Tracy has been amazing with helping us with our puppy!! We were struggling with puppy biting and we were given so many techniques which actually worked! After the sessions, we were given extra material which really helped with our understanding & furthering everything we learnt within the session. Especially for first time dog owners, I would highly recommend!

Thank you again Tracy for all your great help☺️

We worked with Tracy for six weeks to help with our puppy, Charlie, and she was absolutely fantastic! Tracy is so incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and patient — always happy to answer any questions, even outside of our lessons. It’s clear how passionate she is about dogs and how dedicated she is to continually improving her own skills and qualifications.

I looked forward to our weekly sessions so much and genuinely miss them now! Charlie absolutely adored Tracy and has become the perfect dog — calm, balanced, and so well-behaved. I can’t thank Tracy enough for her help and guidance. I couldn’t recommend her more highly!

We have booked Tracy for two block sessions to help us train our cockapoo puppy Minnie. We are first time dog owners and after day 3 with our puppy, we felt totally lost and a bit helpless. We had had 3 nights off no sleep, we were struggling to toilet train, and we were receiving so much conflicting advice we didn’t know what to do for the best. Tracy was so reassuring from the first meeting and has guided us through with patience and so much care ever since. Minnie loves her training with Tracy. She’s warm and kind and intuitive, and has quite literally provided us with a hotline of constant help and advice since Day 1. Minnie has settled into being a loving, sweet puppy who sleeps all night in her crate and takes herself off to the toilet outside and we are now working on recall with Tracy, as Minnie progresses into her next phase of training. We couldn’t recommend Tracy highly enough. She’s brilliant and so supportive and I’m not sure where we would be without her! Thanks Tracy x love Vicki & Tony x

Tracy was a lifesaver for me and helped me keep my cool so many times - going well above the role of trainer! She was in touch before I’d even got my puppy with tips and was flexible in her training and approach when some unexpected problems meant we had to focus on something else. Very responsive too! Thank you!!

Tracy is a very professional, meticulous, and patient dog trainer. Even before Lion came home, I had already booked six lessons with her, focusing on house manners and some outdoor training. Before the training even started, she guided me on how to set up Lion’s space and the equipment he would need. I’m very satisfied with the results of Lion’s training. Along the way, I also learned a lot knowledge from Tracy—for example, how to help Lion ease the discomfort during his teething period.

After the first six lessons, I didn’t hesitate to purchase another package focused on recall training. Compared to other puppies his age, Lion is already doing exceptionally well. Thank you, Tracy—I highly recommend her classes!

We had the best start to puppy life with Tracey for our cocker spaniel, Albert. Her sessions were fun, engaging, and full of practical learning for both us and Albert. Tracy gave us valuable advice and simple, effective techniques that we’ve been able to carry on day to day. We couldn’t have asked for a better beginning to Albert’s training journey!

We are so grateful to found Tracy. She has been working with our dog, Dango, and Dango has made amazing progress. Her behaviour has improved so much in a short amount of time. Dango is now a perfect puppy for us and it's truly all thanks to Tracy's patience, expertise, and clear love for what she does. We couldn't be happier with the results and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a wonderful trainer!

We worked with Tracy when our pup Shilo was just 3 months old, and she was fantastic. She really listened to our priorities, and Shilo picked things up so quickly even after just one session. Tracy made sure we practiced the training ourselves and gave helpful feedback so we could do it right. She was always available for questions and gave great advice between sessions. She’s patient, knowledgeable, and made a real impact on our bond with Shilo. Highly recommend!

We couldn’t be more grateful to Tracy for the incredible impact she’s had on our puppy, Ringo. Thanks to her patient, thoughtful, and expert guidance, Ringo has become such a well-mannered, confident and happy little pup. From mastering basic commands to loose lead walking and recall, Tracy has helped build a strong foundation that we’ll continue to build on for years to come.

She has such a calm, reassuring presence - not just for the dogs, but for the humans too! We always felt supported, never judged, and left each session with practical tips and renewed confidence. Ringo also LOVES her and enjoys his training sessions.

Ringo is such a good boy, and that’s in large part down to Tracy. We couldn’t recommend her more highly.

Tracey from Wagtails had expertise in spades, patience with us all and a very kind and caring attitude towards our puppy. She gave us confidence and competence in how to train our young pup and I’d highly recommend her.

We cannot say enough good things about Tracy. She is without a doubt, an incredibly knowledgeable, intuitive, and supportive dog trainer. From even before the first session, Tracy was able to give advice and recommendations that made real differences for our puppy (and us!). Before we reached out to Tracy we were thinking we could get away with using google and ChatGPT to train our puppy, but honestly, Tracy’s input is completely superior to any online advice. She takes the time to really understand both you and your dog, before offering tailored and actionable advice. She was always on hand via WhatsApp to validate our worries and offer solutions. Then when she came for face to face sessions, she planned the session around our requests, always making the sessions fun for our puppy… and us!!! Thank you Tracy!

We had Tracey as our dog trainer and she was fantastic. We love the way she taught and most importantly she got the results we were looking for with a puppy between 2-4 months old. She is always on hand on WhatsApp for any questions you may have so we really appreciated that and she gave us plenty of information/solutions on issues we raised. Great service!!

We’ve had an amazing experience training our puppy Sandy with Tracy! She’s incredibly attentive and always very responsive whenever I have questions. Sandy has learnt so many important skills and consistently listens to commands both at home and when we’re out and about. Tracy uses positive reinforcement methods, and it’s clear how much Sandy loves her — always a great sign of an excellent trainer. At just six months old, Sandy is regularly complimented by strangers for being so well-behaved for her age, and that’s all thanks to Tracy’s guidance. I couldn’t recommend her highly enough!
Tracy has a wealth of information to share and keeps in touch with us even after the training period has completed.  We've implemented loads of her guidance and seeing great results in our pup!

Tracy has been immensely helpful on life with our new puppy. Tracy is so supportive, kind and always has helpful advice when we need it. Tracy came to visit for our first session the day after we brought Maggie home, despite her being so little she learnt some skills in that very first session. We are very glad we chose Wagtails and would highly recommend Tracy! We know Maggie loves Tracy too 🐶✨
Thank you!

The help we’ve received from Tracy with our rescue pup has been absolutely amazing! Thanks to her invaluable support throughout this journey and the detailed notes she’s been sending us in between sessions, we’ve made real progress with our dog in a very short space of time.
Tracy’s knowledge and patience are vital for any dog owner looking to understand their canine friend better and teach them important skills. We look forward to our next meetings with her and so is Leo, our dog 😊.

Tracy has been an absolute god send when it’s come to our golden retriever puppy! Not only have the training sessions been invaluable but the thorough notes and reassurance in between sessions have made all the difference too! Arnold’s come on leaps and bounds thanks to Tracy and we’re forever grateful! :)

Tracy from Wagtails has been amazing with our little Maltipoo Tyson!!

He arrived at 8wks old and with a new puppy new challenges arrive. We got in touch with Tracy through Bark.com and from the very 1st message Tracy sent us, both my wife and I felt she was genuinely keen to help us and do the very best for Tyson.

Her compassion, professionalism, engagement and undoubted training skills helped us through difficult times and allowed us to embrace puppy hood with greater confidence.

She’s been in regular contact with us, both in / out of the booked sessions and has provided a lot of individualised advice and guidance for Tyson.

The training sessions we had were well planned out, highly interactive and easy to implement.

We’re really grateful for the support she has provided us and would 100% recommend Tracy as a trainer!

My puppy Ethel and I completed the 6 session course with Tracy! Ethel loves Tracy and found the training sessions really fun and we both learnt so much. Would really recommend Tracy to anyone as Ethel’s behaviour has improved so much! Thanks Tracy!
My Cockapoo cost £600 but training is going to cost more than he costs to buy to expensive for me

Tracy absolutely saved us in the first few months of having our golden retriever puppy. She was available via WhatsApp for all my questions (which they were a lot of) and she was constantly checking in to see how things were progressing - always providing guidance and advice on how to improve things. She gives practical advice and understands there isn’t a one-size-fits-all approach to training a dog and is honest in her feedback to you. Can only highly recommend!!

Tracy has been amazing! Having her come to our house and tailoring the training to what was more relevant to us was great. She went on walks with us and showed fun games to play at the park so we could see practical examples of what we can do to have a happy and well behaved puppy.
All her training in focused on positive reinforcement and that shows in our puppy's reaction whenever he sees her: couldnt be more excited!

Tracy truly helped us with our 7 month old pup - Patate. The knowledge she shared over 6 sessions has helped us build great training such as sit, down, recall etc with our Jack Russell. Thank you Tracy!
Thank you Lily!

Can’t recommend Tracy enough. We have done six sessions with our Labrador puppy Sunny and he has made so much progress. Really was a life saver at the start learning to crate train and stop biting and begin learning recall and pavement walking. Thank you !

Tracy, was fantastic! I recommend her to all my friends and anyone who would asked me if I know a good trainer.
I was a bit late with the socialization of my puppy and the transformation she …

I recently worked with Tracy to train my puppy, and I’m so glad I did! Tracy helped us create a clear and effective training plan, and my puppy has improved so much since we started. She was incredibly patient, professional, and provided …

Tracy is amazing!!! We first met when our Sheldon was 2 months old, and she has not only trained him and us, but also supported us along the way saying that we were doing a good job. This brought much confidence and comfort. Tracy has been …

I highly recommend Tracey! Her expertise has been invaluable, and she has supported us every step of the way since we brought our puppy home. We wouldn’t be where we are today without her guidance, and I’m incredibly grateful. Thank you so much for everything, Tracey!

Tracey is brilliant! We all learned so much during our sessions and our puppy is brilliantly behaved now. We would recommend Wagtails to anyone looking for puppy or dog training, as Tracey is not only knowledgeable and patient, she makes the sessions fun for pups and humans. Thank you Tracey, from us and Lady
